For a bar with centre line direction (dx, dy) and normal (nx, ny), half-width w=5, the bar is points p = t*(dx,dy) + s*(nx,ny) with |s|≤5. Given y, solve for x range: y = t*dy + s*ny => t = (y - s*ny)/dy. x = t*dx + s*nx = (y - s*ny)*dx/dy + s*nx = y*dx/dy + s*(nx - ny*dx/dy).

For bar A: dx=-sin24=-0.40674, dy=cos24=0.91355. dx/dy = -tan24 = -0.44523. Normal nA = (cos24, sin24) = (0.91355, 0.40674). nx - ny*dx/dy = 0.91355 - 0.40674*(-0.44523) = 0.91355 + 0.18110 = 1.09465. So x = y*(-0.44523) + s*1.09465, s∈[-5,5]. At y=1.25: x = -0.55654 + s*1.09465, so x from -6.0298 to 4.9167. At y=-1.25: x = 0.55654 + s*1.09465, x from -4.9167 to 6.0298.
